# lazy() Only Works with Default Exports

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## lazy() Only Works with Default Exports

Here's the constraint: lazy() expects import() to resolve to { default: Component }.

All of our page files already use export default, so we're covered.

But if a file uses a named export instead, the lazy() call will resolve but React won't find the component.

This produces a runtime error, not a build-time one, which makes it harder to catch.

![lazy() Only Works with Default Exports](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

But what if we need to lazy-load a named export from a third-party library?

There's a solution for that. Click Next Lesson to learn about it.
